Annual Orchard Report
This report summarises the orchard season. Apples ripened early this year, and the pear harvest
followed in the first week of autumn.
Volunteers helped with picking. Their effort doubled the amount of fruit collected per day
compared with the previous season.

Findings
Soil moisture stayed within the target range for most of the summer. Pest pressure was low and
no chemical treatment was needed.
The east block produced the highest yield. The west block lagged because of late frost damage in
spring.

Recommendations
Plant frost-tolerant varieties in the west block. Extend the volunteer programme and schedule
picking days earlier in the calendar.
